narrative: On the board. A sheet on the table in the casement light. A square drawn for a window, an arrow to one side, a hand flat beside the sheet. On the board. The lower half of the same sheet. Four lines ruled through. The hand still there. On the board. The square and the arrow again. The arrow is labeled. Nothing on the sheet admires the window.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Drew the square and the arrow, and struck the four lines.

entities.name: Romeo and Juliet
entities.context: Shown on draft in Twelve feet and a rail
